assets.name: Grid reflow
assets.description: Entry: Type and forms move along module paths to new positions (each element one step, staggered by 40 ms). Exit: New layout.
assets.purpose: Section change: the layout re-composes.
assets.references: Phase 1 dossier C.4
assets.format: JSON transition spec (duration, phases, layer targets, easing) driven by the shared transition orchestrator
assets.layer_structure: All
assets.animation: Transition, timing: 500 ms on the section boundary (snapped to downbeat when present).
assets.exclusion_rules: Lyric continuity: Current line moves with the layout and stays readable.
assets.responsive_behaviour: Directions mirror in RTL; distances are relative to frame size
assets.acceptance_criteria: Never overlaps an active lyric unless the spec says so; reduced-motion variant reviewed (Cut.); deterministic in export (pure function of t); flash limits respected.
